description.value: Anita's Bread & Coffee is an organic cafe and bakery housed inside the Anita's Organic Milling facility on South Sumas Road in Chilliwack, operated by Nature's Path Organic Foods. The bakery follows a rotating daily sourdough schedule — producing loaves such as country white, medium rye, miche, vollkornbrot, einkorn, and seasonal fougasse — all baked fresh each morning. It also serves as a baking education centre showcasing Anita's Organic Milling grains and flours, alongside organic coffee and a range of vegan-friendly pastries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully available and confirms an operating organic cafe and bakery at the OSM address (Unit 615, 44688 South Sumas Rd, Chilliwack), with phone (604) 845-6191 present on the website but absent from OSM tags. The website name is consistently 'ANITA'S BREAD & COFFEE' — without the word 'Organic' — differing from the OSM name 'Anita's Organic Bread & Coffee'. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null.
